name: BAPADI ROTLI
description: Layered thin rotlis are a delicacy, traditionally eaten with Keri No Ras. They are time consuming but worth the effort.
method: Mix all the ingredients and knead to a soft dough. Cover and keep for 15-20 minutes. Knead again. Divide it into 2 parts. Sub-divide each part into 7 equal portions. Make round balls.
Press each round ball a little and roll out seven little rotlis.

Smear a little ghee on top of the first rotli. Sprinkle a little flour over it (optional). Place the second rotli on it. Apply ghee and sprinkle flour on the second rotli. Continue till the seventh rotli. Do not apply any ghee or flour over it.
These layers of 7 small rotlis form one set. Gently roll out the set evenly to a round of diameter.
Pre- heat a griddle on medium flame. Roast one set of rotlis on it. As small brown spots appear on the underside of the bottom rotli, gently flip the set to the other side and roast again.
Within 2-3 minutes, the set of rotlis will start puffing up. With a folded cloth, gently press the middle and then the edges of the rotlis.
The rotlis by now are cooked and slightly brown on both the sides. Remove them on a plate (thali). Let them cool for a minute or two.
Gently separate each rotli from the set. As you separate, apply ghee on them.
Pile the rotlis on each other and wrap them in a muslin cloth.
Repeat the process with the other set. Store in a steel box or a casserole.
notes: From the set of 7 rotlis, only 5 of them are soft.
The outer 2 rotlis are crisp. Roast them to make khakhras.
Each set may consist of 5, 6, 7, or more rotlis.

Mix the flour and ghee till it resembles breadcrumbs.
Add little water to bind semi soft dough.
Divide the dough into 200 equal portions.
Make different shapes from each portion (as diagram).
Dry the shapes for 3-4 hours. Keep aside. For Melted Jaggery: Start to melt jaggery after the dough shapes have dried.
On a low flame melt jaggery with little water in a pan. Keep stirring till smooth and no lumps are left. Sieve. Cook till it reaches a coating consistency.
On a medium flame, heat ghee in a frying pan. Lower the flame. Deep fry few dough shapes at a time, till light golden brown in colour. They should be well cooked inside and outside.
Immediately dip the fried shapes in the melted jaggery. Coat them all over.

name: MESUR
description: A traditional mithai of besan is whisked vigorously in one direction with sugar and hot ghee to get a net like texture.
method: Method 1:
On a low flame, sauté flour in cup ghee, till light golden in colour. Keep aside. For the Sugar Syrup:
Mix sugar and water in a heavy bottomed pan. On a medium flame, simmer till the sugar melts. Add milk. Remove the scum.
Simmer the syrup till it thickens to 1 thread consistency.
After the scum is removed from the syrup:
Simultaneously on a low flame, melt ghee in another pan. Keep it very hot, till the sugar syrup thickens to a 1 thread consistency.
To the sugar syrup, slowly add the sautéed flour. Stir well only in one direction till it blends well.
Gradually pour cup of hot ghee thinly, in the center of the mixture. On a high flame, stir vigorously with a steel spatula. Repeat this 3-4 times till all the ghee is used.
The mixture will expand and net like holes will appear. It will change to a light brown colour. The ghee will separate. Switch off the flame.
Pour the mixture in a steel colander placed in a deep steel plate. Let the ghee drain off. Collect that ghee in another pan.

Immediately pour and spread the mixture thick in the same plate (without the ghee). Sprinkle water all over the mixture. More holes will appear. Sprinkle cardamom seeds on it. Gently cut into equal square pieces.
As the mesur cools and sets, remove the pieces. Store in an airtight container. MESUR: Method 2
Mix all the ingredients in a heavy bottomed pan.
On a low flame, cook the mixture. Stir continuously.
Keep stirring till the mixture feels very light.
Pour the mixture in a thali. The ghee will start to separate. Tilt thali. Remove the extra ghee. Level the mixture thick. Sprinkle cardamom seeds on it.
Gently cut into equal square pieces. Let it cool and set. Remove pieces. Store in an airtight container. Mesur will have a double colour. 215
